manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball rising and falling alongside its velocity-time graph, illustrating that acceleration and force remain constant even when velocity passes through zero at the apex.
manifest.description: Left: A vertical track showing a tossed ball with live velocity and acceleration arrows and readouts. Right: A velocity-time plot showing a straight line with constant negative slope passing through zero velocity at the top of the toss.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
